# Minecraft Guides Wiki

> A comprehensive resource for Minecraft modding guides, mod directories, and wiki documentation across Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge loaders.

Minecraft Guides Wiki serves as a central hub for players seeking curated mod recommendations, detailed mod wikis, and compatibility information. The site aggregates guides for popular mods like Farmer's Delight, Aquamirae, and Relics, alongside comprehensive mod loader documentation and themed mod collections.

## Core Resources

- [Home - Minecraft Guides Wiki](https://www.minecraft-guides.com): Homepage for Minecraft Guides Wiki featuring mod guides and gameplay enhancements.
- [Minecraft: Forge, Fabric, & NeoForge Mods Directory - Minecraft Guides Wiki](https://www.minecraft-guides.com/mods): Complete mod directory with Forge, Fabric, NeoForge guides and compatibility info.
- [Minecraft Mod Lists - Minecraft Guides Wiki](https://www.minecraft-guides.com/mod-lists): Curated Minecraft mod lists organized by theme, version, and mod loader.

## Mod Wikis & Guides

- [Minecraft: Farmer's Delight Wiki - Minecraft Guides Wiki](https://www.minecraft-guides.com/wiki/farmers-delight): Farmer's Delight mod wiki covering farming, cooking mechanics, and recipes.
- [Minecraft: Aquamirae Mod Wiki - Minecraft Guides Wiki](https://www.minecraft-guides.com/wiki/aquamirae): Aquamirae mod wiki covering bosses, mobs, crafting, and ocean structures.
- [Stalwart Dungeons Wiki - Minecraft Guides Wiki](https://www.minecraft-guides.com/wiki/stalwart-dungeons): Stalwart Dungeons mod wiki with dungeon guides, bosses, and loot across dimensions.
- [Bosses of Mass Destruction Wiki - Minecraft Guides Wiki](https://www.minecraft-guides.com/wiki/bosses-of-mass-destruction): Bosses of Mass Destruction mod wiki with boss guides and loot information.
- [Relics Wiki - Minecraft Guides Wiki](https://www.minecraft-guides.com/wiki/relics): Relics mod wiki detailing artifacts, abilities, and mod compatibility.
